title.zh-CN: 多线路更新与国内连接优化
title.en-US: Multiple update routes and connection selection

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：检测 GitHub 与两条公共加速线路的真实内容，自动选择有效来源并在下载失败时回退
summary.en-US: Development preview: validate real content from GitHub and two public proxy routes, select a valid source and fall back when downloads fail

zh-CN: 新增自动选择、GitHub 直连、GHFast、GH-Proxy 连接方式，记住选择并显示当前线路
自动模式同时检测实际公告和签名清单，不把域名能连接或错误页面当作有效更新
收到有效响应后短暂收集其他线路，优先使用最新有效签名信息，下载失败时自动回退
切换下载线路后从头下载并重置进度，继续校验 HTTPS、发布签名、文件大小与 SHA-256
缓存来源与 ETag 绑定，离线仍可查看当前版本说明和可用的在线缓存
公共加速服务由第三方运营，不承诺持续可用，后续可加入自有国内 HTTPS 镜像
en-US: Choose Automatic, GitHub direct, GHFast or GH-Proxy; the editor remembers your preference and shows the current route
Automatic mode checks actual announcements and signed manifests, rejecting connection-only success and error pages
Collect other routes briefly after a valid response, prefer the latest valid signed information and fall back when downloads fail
Restart downloads and reset progress when switching routes, retaining HTTPS, signature, size and SHA-256 checks
Bind cached ETags to their source; keep the current build notes and usable online cache available offline
Public proxy services are operated by third parties without an availability promise; an owner-controlled HTTPS mirror can be added later

title.zh-CN: 在线更新下载兼容修复

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：保留 GitHub 下载跳转地址的完整编码，避免将合法更新下载误判为无效地址
summary.en-US: Development preview: preserve the exact encoding of GitHub download redirects so valid updates are accepted

zh-CN: 修复 Qt 显示格式解码下载地址后触发安全检查的问题，继续验证 HTTPS、目标域名、发布签名和文件哈希
保留在线公告、下载进度、取消、重启替换与旧程序备份恢复流程
v1.5 与预览 r1–r5 用户请先从 Release 手动下载此版，之后可使用程序内更新
en-US: Fix a redirect encoding issue while retaining HTTPS, host, signature and file-integrity checks
Keep online announcements, progress, cancellation, restart replacement and backup recovery
Users of v1.5 and previews r1–r5 should download this build from Releases once, then use in-app updates

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：在编辑器内查看在线公告，下载新版并重启完成替换
summary.en-US: Development preview: read online news, download a new build and restart to apply it

title.en-US: Keep the editor up to date

zh-CN: 本地只保留当前版本说明，在线公告与历史记录独立刷新
正式版与预览版分别检查，可在更新窗口选择通道
下载显示进度并支持取消，使用发布签名、文件大小和 SHA-256 验证更新包
重启更新前处理未保存的编辑，更新助手保留旧程序并在替换或启动失败时恢复
断网或更新失败时保留当前程序和皮肤，仍可离线编辑
en-US: Only the current build notes are bundled; online news and history refresh separately
Check stable and preview channels independently and choose a channel in the update window
Download with progress and cancellation, verifying the signed release manifest, file size and SHA-256
Resolve unsaved edits before restarting; the update helper keeps the previous executable and rolls back on replacement or startup failure
Continue editing offline when the network or update is unavailable, preserving the current app and skins

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：在程序内了解新功能，也能随时回看之前的更新
summary.en-US: Development preview: discover new features and revisit earlier updates without leaving the editor

zh-CN: 首次遇到新公告时自动显示，读过的公告不会在每次启动时重复弹出
在公告窗口切换历史记录，查看开发预览与已发布版本分别更新了什么
可从菜单手动打开公告，不必等待下一次启动
可关闭启动时自动显示，之后仍能手动查看全部公告
en-US: New announcements appear once on startup instead of reopening after every launch
Browse the history to see changes in development previews and published versions
Open announcements from the menu whenever you need them
Turn off automatic startup announcements while keeping the full history available

title.en-US: Standard scenes and a separate preview window

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：补齐舞台侧图，在独立窗口检查 Standard 与 Mania 的皮肤画面
summary.en-US: Development preview: inspect Standard and Mania skins in a separate window, with stage artwork restored

zh-CN: Standard 新增混合、圆圈、滑条和转盘自动测试场景，保留单个圆圈的素材检查
调整 CS 圆圈大小和 AR 缩圈速度，暂停查看判定图与连击图，设置仅影响预览
Standard 显示皮肤血条装饰、分数与准确率字体，使用示例血量和内置排列，不读取谱面或播放音乐
Mania 补齐常驻舞台侧图和舞台底部动画，保留皮肤图片自身的透明边距
轨道、侧图与大幅插画统一缩放，可选择 16:10、16:9 或 4:3 画面比例
使用独立预览窗口和 F11 全屏查看，关闭窗口后可回到原来的编辑界面
en-US: Standard gains mixed, circle, slider and spinner scenes, alongside the single-circle asset inspector
Adjust CS and AR for the preview, then pause to inspect judgement and combo artwork
Standard displays skin health-bar artwork, score and accuracy fonts using sample health and built-in patterns, without beatmaps or music
Mania now displays persistent stage-side artwork and animated stage bottoms while preserving transparent margins
Columns and artwork share one scene scale, with 16:10, 16:9 and 4:3 viewport options
Move the preview into its own window, use F11 for fullscreen and close it to return to the editor

title.zh-CN: 长条圆角与连击显示修复
title.en-US: Hold-note artwork and combo display fixes

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：改善长条主体、尾部定位和连击数字的显示，更准确地保留皮肤原有设计
summary.en-US: Development preview: improve hold bodies, tail placement and combo effects to better preserve the skin's design

zh-CN: 修复部分长条尾端显示成平口的问题，保留 Capoo 等皮肤画在主体顶部的圆角和透明留白
长按时裁切剩余主体，不再把原图反复拉伸，透明尾图也参与定位
支持更多长条样式名称、各列设置与方向选项
连击数字读取皮肤的长按和断连颜色，加入命中弹跳与断连扩散效果
试玩判定加入缩放和淡出，单独检查判定图时保持原尺寸并播放素材动画
en-US: Fix flat-looking hold ends by preserving rounded artwork and transparent padding at the top of bodies used by skins such as Capoo
Crop the remaining hold body as it is held instead of repeatedly stretching it, and account for transparent tail images
Support more named body styles, per-column settings and direction options
Apply the skin's hold and combo-break colours, with hit pulses and combo-break effects
Animate gameplay judgements with scaling and fading while keeping the dedicated inspector at the artwork's original size

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：用自动测试或键盘试玩检查音符、长条、判定图与连击素材
summary.en-US: Development preview: inspect notes, holds, judgements and combo artwork through autoplay or keyboard practice

zh-CN: 新增自动测试与键盘试玩，保留循环预览，使用 60 秒内置排列
选择混合、普通音符、长条或和弦，切换 1–18K 并查看对应键位提示
按列读取普通音符、长条头身尾及按键按下素材，支持自定义路径、高清图片和连续动画
单独检查大 PERFECT、小 PERFECT、GREAT、GOOD、BAD、MISS，以及连击数字和连击插画
查看实际素材路径与缺失引用，按 Esc 或切出场地时暂停，填写配置时不会误触发试玩
试玩采用简化计分和独立长条头尾判定，不读取游戏谱面或播放歌曲
en-US: Choose autoplay or keyboard practice with a built-in 60-second pattern, or keep using the looping preview
Try mixed notes, taps, holds or chords across 1–18 keys with visible key-binding hints
Load each column's notes, hold parts and pressed keys from custom paths, including high-resolution images and frame animations
Inspect both PERFECT tiers, GREAT, GOOD, BAD and MISS, plus combo digits and combo-burst artwork
Check actual asset paths and missing references, pause with Esc or when leaving the playfield, and edit settings without triggering notes
Practice uses simplified scoring with separate hold-head and tail judgements, without loading beatmaps or playing songs

title.zh-CN: Mania 设计器与科技风界面
title.en-US: Mania Designer and a refreshed interface

summary.zh-CN: 已发布版本：调整上隐与球槽高度，保存皮肤副本，并使用新的素材工作台
summary.en-US: Published version: design upper masks and receptor height, save a skin copy and use the refreshed asset workspace

zh-CN: 新增上隐高度、渐变、颜色与底部球槽加高，可联动调整判定位置
将设计保存为独立皮肤副本，为所选键数生成素材，保留原皮肤
Mania 预览增加流速、BPM、键数、判定参考线与重置操作
采用小蓝头像与深蓝冰青界面，右上角提供独立的语言切换入口
素材库支持搜索、分类、图片查看与音频试听，素材替换后刷新预览
修复滚轮误改数值、高清素材定位及配置保存问题，保留配置备份和历史快照
en-US: Adjust upper-mask height, fade and colour, raise receptors and optionally move the hit position with them
Save the design as a separate skin copy with generated assets for the selected key count, preserving the original skin
Control Mania preview speed, BPM, key count, the hit-position guide and restart
Use the Xiaolan avatar and deep-blue interface, with a dedicated language selector in the top-right corner
Search and filter assets, inspect images, preview audio and refresh the scene after replacements
Fix accidental scroll-wheel edits, high-resolution asset placement and configuration saving while retaining backups and history
